headline: New EU Directive: Greater Tools to Protect Air, Citizens and the Environment
summary: Italy's Council of Ministers recently approved an initiative on air quality, described as new measures implementing an EU directive to protect air and citizens. Details were limited in the source.
why: EU environmental directives set compliance obligations for industry and transport, which can translate into costs and regulatory risk for affected sectors.
